correctness.rationale: Conditional Poisson independence gives the host-zero and parasite-zero transforms and their joint zero transform; those three numbers determine all four cells at a given effort. Multiplication by the lowest-rate exponential and taking the large-effort limit, followed by subtraction and iteration, recovers exponents and multiplicities, including repeated paired sums. Equal effort therefore gives precisely the two named marginals and sum multiset, no less and no more. The two permutations at n=2 have sums of squared rates differing by 2(a₁−a₂)(b₁−b₂), nonzero; n=1 is immediate. Each stated triple has marginal lists {2,4,6} and {1,3,5} and sum list {5,7,9}; the parasite-rate-above-host counts are two and one respectively. A collision at positive ratio c between distinct cells with both coordinates different requires c=(aᵢ−aⱼ)/(bₗ−bₖ), and distinct individual lists exclude a collision with only one index different. Thus outside the finite list the diagonal marginals give the candidate grid and an oblique projection identifies the cell behind each observed exponent. Include c≠1 to ensure an unequal-effort family even if 1 happens not to be forbidden. Here E={1/2,1,2}, so 3/2 separates all cells. The supplied verify_alias.py was inspected, not executed; it compares exact rate fingerprints and enumerates finite matchings, rather than evaluating exponential probabilities at finite effort. The conclusions require exact curves, equal weights and the stated distinctness and conditional independence, not a finite sample.

originality.rationale: The sharp mathematical obstruction is covered by classical finite X-ray switching components. Ghiglione's 2019 open thesis gives the identical three-versus-three point configuration after a coordinate reflection and positive affine scaling, preserving distinct host and parasite coordinates, and cites Rényi for the matching lower bound over real point sets. The full binary Poisson curve is just an invertible encoding of the three projections in this model. The proposed repair also reduces immediately to choosing a direction that separates all cells of the already known finite grid. The explicit effort ratio and ecological names do not leave a distinct mathematical result; this judgment rests on positive coverage and the reduction, not unsuccessful literature retrieval.

value.rationale: The ecological interpretation is a useful illustration of what diagonal co-detection can hide, but the rate lists were chosen from a standard switching configuration and the observation design merely distinguishes finitely many known candidate pairs by assigning them different projected numbers. The frozen claim supplies no new mathematical obstruction or design criterion under ecological constraints, no statistical guarantee and no empirical inference distinct from the projection example. The failure is the lack of a substantive research contribution beyond a relabeling, not the absence of noisy-data analysis by itself.
